intent: M3 final RAM-only dual-band Wi-Fi AP + LuCI 19.07 + full-MTU wired Gigabit candidate (v5.6.5-m3-final-ramboot): builds on hardware-verified v5.6.4 (zero panic, clean VLAN 1/2-only switch0 via rtl8367s_clear_stale_vlans, ucidef_add_switch topology, FLOWOFFLOAD software flow_offloading, block_relay=0 + PC-to-5G ping 7ms via multicast_to_unicast=0, WEXT freq/rate/txpow/operstate via rtl_giwtxpow, uhttpd-mod-lua LuCI login, 27.4 MiB free RAM, 0 UART n=512 noise) and fixes the remaining audited Wi-Fi performance/regulatory/WEXT/survey bugs — enables TX A-MPDU (ampdu=1) and Short GI (shortGI20M=1, shortGI40M=1, shortGI80M=1 on 5 GHz) in rtl8192cd.sh, aligns rtl_country_to_regdomain + emits countrystr/country2reg so map_country_to_reg never overwrites non-US countries back to US, fixes rtl_giwencode() dummy length=16 with IW_ENCODE_NOKEY so iwconfig shows encrypted WPA2 instead of off, and fixes rsd0614-survey (BusyBox tr \040-\176, non-64K cr6c-end/4KiB read-only mtd2ro scanner, uhttpd ps args, radio0 factory RF dmesg, br-lan multicast_to_unicast, gpio-button-hotplug); all 6 MTD partitions stay strictly read-only, pcie1 and unverified LEDs stay disabled, persistent flash stays NO-GO
